why: FAR1 (11p15.3) provides the fatty alcohol substrate for AGPS Step 2 ether-bond formation. FAR1 LOF → no fatty alcohol → AGPS cannot form ether bond → plasmalogens severely low. why: PEX13 (2p15) encodes a 403-aa type II integral PMP with a C-terminal SH3 domain (cytoplasmic) that is a core component of the importomer (PEX13·PEX14·PEX17 docking/translocation complex). PEX13 SH3 domain directly binds WxxxF/WxxxY motifs in PEX5 (PTS1 receptor). PEX13 LOF → importomer structurally compromised → PEX5 cannot dock → ALL matrix import fails.
